description: Figure 2, titled “Individual vs Ensemble Models,” is a line plot that illustrates the trade-off between cost and reliability score for three different model configurations. The horizontal x-axis, labeled “Cost,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 10, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The vertical y-axis, labeled “Reliability Score,” ranges from 30 to 90, with major gridlines and tick labels at 30, 50, 70, and 90. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue line with circular markers representing the “3-Model Ensemble,” a red line with circular markers for the “2-Model Ensemble,” and a yellow line with circular markers for “GPT-4.” The blue line begins near a reliability score of 85 at cost 0 and gradually declines to approximately 75 at cost 10. The red line starts slightly lower, near 83, and also trends downward to about 73 at cost 10. In contrast, the yellow line for GPT-4 starts at approximately 90 and exhibits a steep, near-linear decline to around 40 at cost 10, indicating a much sharper drop in reliability as cost increases compared to the ensemble models.
